# Assumption of Moses Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Coming Western King and Priestly Rule

---

**5:1** And there will come upon them a powerful king of the west who will conquer them and take possession of them.

**5:2** He will carry off their captives as plunder and will take some of them with him to his own land.

**5:3** And he will burn part of their sanctuary with fire and will crucify some of them around their city.

**5:4** In those days a king will arise who will be insolent and will have no respect for anyone, a man who will rule them as they deserve.

**5:5** He will judge them as they judged others, for they will have polluted the holy things of the Lord.

**5:6** And for twenty years he will afflict them.

**5:7** Then will arise a man of the tribe of Levi who shall fear the Lord and be moved by justice.

**5:8** His sons will rule after him for many years.

**5:9** And after a short time the kingdom will be diminished, and troops of foreign origin and impure descent will stir it up.

**5:10** And then a powerful king will come from the west, and he will conquer them and take them with him.

**5:11** These commanders will become petty rulers and will have power over many nations.

**5:12** They will burn a temple with fire and will take gold from it.

**5:13** Those who live in the land will then be in great distress for a long time.

**5:14** And there will be a time appointed for the Lord to deal with them.
